issues.legal_issue: Municipal house and water taxes paid by a lessor are deductible from the annual value of property as annual charges that are not capital charges to which the property is subject.
material_facts: The dispute arose in an income-tax assessment concerning income from property.
House tax and water tax were imposed by a municipality on the annual value of buildings or land.
The owner paid the taxes as lessor because the property was let.
The municipal law made sums due for these taxes a first charge on the property.
The relevant municipal tax provisions were substantially similar to those considered in an earlier Supreme Court decision.
issues.conclusion: The house tax and water tax were deductible from the bona fide annual value of the property; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 9(1)(iv) of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922 permits deduction from annual value of annual charges that are not capital charges to which the property is subject. The Court applied this provision, read with section 9(1) and (2), to municipal taxes imposed under sections 128 and 149 of the United Provinces Municipalities Act, 1916, noting the first charge created by section 177. It followed New Piecegoods Bazar Co. Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Bombay ([1950] S.C.R. 553).

predicates.property_income_tax_assessment: The proceeding concerns the assessment of income from property for income-tax purposes.
predicates.municipal_taxes_based_on_annual_value: A municipality imposes taxes on property by reference to its annual value.
predicates.lessor_liable_for_taxes: The owner pays the taxes because the property is let and the owner is liable for them as lessor.
predicates.taxes_are_noncapital_charges_on_property: The taxes are recurring, non-capital charges to which the property is subject.

issues.definition: When a property-income tax assessment involves municipal taxes based on annual value that the lessor is liable to pay as non-capital charges on the property, those taxes are deductible from the property's annual value.
